items.title: Player interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2012
items.q: the other day I performed with Dr. Michael White for somebody’s birthday party.

ctx.x: What’s a typical week or month like for you, as a working musician?

Wooo. A typical week? Typical is, right now I’m also working, you know I have a day job because I do it mostly because I have a decent insurance policy, you know, health insurance. So I do that. I work that job, like 30 hours a week, maybe a little more, and then I might do, I don’t know, four or five gigs, three or four gigs a week, and usually a couple of times I’m performing at Preservation Hall jazz club, and then it could vary from private engagements. Like the other day I performed with Dr. Michael White…
Yeah, I mean it’s similar up here. You get — a gig is a gig.
